manaNeeded: {0} plus the mana cost of the creature in your hand
easyPrerequisites: All-Fates Stalker must be exiled by Hostage Taker, and Phantom Steed must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
description:
Cast Phantom Steed for its mana cost.
When Phantom Steed enters, it exiles Hostage Taker until Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Phantom Steed's ETB.
When Hostage Taker leaves the battlefield, All-Fates Stalker is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When All-Fates Stalker enters, it exiles Phantom Steed until All-Fates Stalker leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of All-Fates Stalker's ETB.
When Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield, Hostage Taker is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Hostage Taker enters, it exiles All-Fates Stalker until Hostage Taker leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Hostage Taker's ETB.
When All-Fates Stalker leaves the battlefield, Phantom Steed is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
